name: Resume and job competency assistance
summary: Score a candidate's stated evidence against each job competency.

input.state: The competency definition followed by the candidate's relevant resume text.

competency.instructions: How strongly does the supplied evidence show this competency?
competency.criteria: Score only what the state shows.

outputs.shape: met/unmet per competency; the caller assembles the competency matrix

uncertainty.abstain: absent evidence scores low - the recipe reads what is written and never infers experience
uncertainty.refusal: a refused pair reports refused and the competency stays unassessed

limits: Assists screening, never decides hiring - a human reviews every matrix.
Scores stated evidence, not the person; resume quality bounds it.

examples.api: POST /v1/systemone per item, or /v1/classify with items as inputs
examples.mcp: oak-mcp ask tool with the same envelope

evidence.label: unmeasured
evidence.note: Composition is verified over recorded answers by crates/gym/tests/recipes.rs; model-quality measurement runs through a gym suite and is pinned here only when it exists.
